To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

caregiver burden in FTD is influenced by different factors depending on the caregiver's relationship to the person with dementia, with spousal caregivers being influenced by the disease severity and child caregivers being influenced by their own depression.

(1) spousal and non-resident child caregivers of people with FTD experience comparable levels of burden, regardless of dementia severity; (2) non-resident child caregiver burden was associated with caregiver social network; (3) spousal caregiver and non-resident caregiver burden was associated, respectively, with dementia severity and caregiver depression.
Caregiver burden, depression, and stress are similar between spousal and adult child caregivers of persons with frontotemporial dementia.
